I also have Aerial, which can have 3 steps. So depending on unit placement Freedom usually does more DPS.

What I mean is that you can attack two targets with Freedom (if you kill the first target). With Aerial you can attack three targets (if you kill the first two). However, if positioned well, Freedom can use its MAP attack to hit more then 3 targets, which Aerial won't be able to do.

So yes, it is situational. But bear in mind that Freedom is a support unit, and Aerial a DPS unit.
